meta.name: Life, Larry and the Pursuit of Unhappiness: An Almost History of America
meta.description: An improvised, comedic approach to major events in American history in celebration of the 250th anniversary of the founding of the United States.

videos.title: Livingston
videos.overview: Robert Livingston takes a first pass at the Declaration of Independence. Rosa Parks settles in for an uncomfortable bus ride.

videos.title: Farewell
videos.overview: Meriwether Lewis shares news of his upcoming travels with his long-suffering wife. Larry presses George Washington for answers.

videos.title: McCarthy
videos.overview: Larry crashes a party in Boston Harbor. Jonesy makes a stop on the Underground Railroad. The Wright Brothers prepare for their first flight. Senator Joe McCarthy calls out his fellow congressmen for their problematic conduct.

videos.title: Deepthroat
videos.overview: Bob Woodward receives some questionable intel. Henry Ford is forced to take a local mensch out for a test drive. Bachelor president James Buchanan tries his luck with the ladies. Vaccine pioneer Jonas Salk makes his mother a little too proud.

videos.title: Lincoln
videos.overview: Larry plays a key role during the showdown at the O.K. Corral. President Lincoln receives advice from his Chief of Staff, Lawrence Butterfield. President Johnson recruits Butterfield to help convince a grieving Mary Todd to move out of the White House.

videos.title: Buzz
videos.overview: After Paul Revere issues his warning, Larry and his wife prepare to flee. At the Alamo, Davy Crockett hides a crucial secret. Susan B. Anthony deals with a rude dinner guest. Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin butt heads during their lunar mission.

videos.title: Lawrence
videos.overview: Larry gets caught up in the moment on VJ Day. After delivering a lengthy speech, President William Henry Harrison falls ill. Rescuers question the surviving members of the Donner Party. In 2014, President Obama makes waves for his apparel decisions.
